subject: Demo takeaways + proposed 3-week bakeoff plan
content:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@summerwell.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@summerwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo takeaways + proposed 3-week bakeoff plan

Hi Jordan / Alex —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and clear sense that Summerwell has a real production use for doc understanding + summarization at scale. Below is a short recap from our demo and a concrete proposal for a 3-week "bakeoff" (lightweight POC) so you can validate latency, cost, and quality in your environment.

Quick demo recap
- Primary goals you shared: ingest historical clinical notes, extract structured fields, and generate short patient summaries for clinician triage.
- Constraints: < 1s median token latency for short prompts, data residency in us-east-1, and a <20% token-cost uplift vs current baseline.
- Risk items: PHI handling & audit logs, sampling bias on historical notes, and query throughput for concurrent workflows.

Proposed 3-week bakeoff (high level)
Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): access provisioning, baseline test harness, and ingest 2k anonymized notes (you provide); Redwood provides an evaluation plan and a preconfigured model container.
Week 1 (sanity & integration, 5 business days): run end-to-end tests on sample flows, measure latency/throughput, iterate on prompts and tokenization/caching settings.
Week 2 (stress & quality, 5 business days): run parallel queries to match production concurrency, run labeled quality checks on a 300-record sample against your acceptance prompts.
Week 3 (analysis & handoff, 5 business days): compile results, run a short stakeholder demo, and deliver a remediation list + recommended config for production.

Success criteria (examples — we will finalize with you)
- Median response latency for 1-2 sentence prompts: <= 1.0s (95th <= 1.6s)
- Throughput: sustain 120 concurrent small requests with <2x latency degradation
- Quality: >= 85% precision on 5 key extraction fields on the labeled 300-record sample
- Cost target: unit token-cost <= 20% above your current benchmark (we'll instrument token accounting)
- Security: trial runs inside your VPC or with agreed data handling; audit logs enabled for every request

Owner map (recommended)
- Summerwell data & legal lead: Jordan Price — provide anonymized sample + security contacts
- Redwood SE lead: Karthik Iyer — bench & model config, ingestion scripts (cc'd)
- Redwood CS lead: Marissa Cole — onboarding, success criteria tracking, and demo runbook

Attachments (sent with this email):
- summerwell-eval-plan-v1.pdf (evaluation playbook with test cases & metrics)
- sample-data-schema.csv (expected columns and anonymization checklist)

Next steps / asks for you
1) Confirm that a 3-week bakeoff fits your timeline and whether we can start the week of May 22.
2) Share a small anonymized sample (2k notes) or confirm we can use a synthetic slice for Week 0.
3) Who on your security team should we loop in for a short checklist (KYC: SOC2 scope / KMS)?

If that all looks good I can kick off a calendar invite for a 60-minute kick-off + technical runbook session and share the Drive link to the eval plan.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Soojin — this is helpful and concrete. A few quick clarifications before we confirm dates:
- Data residency: we need the trial environment to be in our us-east-1 account / VPC if possible. Is that supported for the bakeoff?
- SLA / uptime: for the test we don't need a production SLA, but we do need audit logs and request-level tracing enabled.
- Metric baselines: can you propose a short set of latency/throughput tests we can run in-house so we can compare apples-to-apples with our current infra?

I'll check with our security lead (cc'ing Alex) and loop them in if they want to run the checklist. If we can host in our VPC, the week of May 22 looks workable but I'd prefer starting May 23 to give security a day to triage.

Jordan
CTO, Summerwell Health

Jordan — quick technical notes from the SE side:
- We can absolutely run the trial inside your VPC via our Private deployment pattern for short evaluation windows. We'll work with your cloud ops to provide a prebuilt container image and a short Terraform snippet to stand up the evaluation stack.
- For apples-to-apples latency testing: we'll include a JMeter script and a small client harness to replay 1k representative prompts at 50/100/200 concurrency levels (attached sample-data-schema.csv shows the expected input shape).
- Model recommendation: start with redwood-optimized-7b-quant for the first run (good latency / cost balance). If you want higher recall for extraction we can run a 13B variant in Week 2 as a comparison.

I'll drop the Terraform snippet and the harness into the Drive link after we confirm the start date.
